answer_span.rule: Score the suffix of tokenize(prompt + city, add_special_tokens=True) after requiring the prompt prefix to match tokenize(prompt). Do not insert a space, EOS, or padding.
answer_span.why_not_standalone_city_ids: LlamaTokenizerFast encode(city, add_special_tokens=False) inserts a leading space marker. Those ids are not the tokens of the city string appended after [/INST]. They are recorded as a diagnostic and are not the scored span.

anchor.name: question_mark
anchor.rule: Exactly one prompt token whose piece is '?'.

layer_map.layers_0_to_30_vector: hidden_states[l+1] at the question mark; a read-only hook on layers[l] must match this vector
layer_map.layer_31_vector: forward-hook output of layers[31] before the final RMSNorm; this is not hidden_states[32]
layer_map.hidden_states_32: final RMSNorm output; not a patch site
layer_map.patch_strength: full residual replacement at the question-mark position only

positive_delta_meaning: donor or noise patch lowered support for the city span; this is not forgetting success

nomination.median: sort ascending; odd count takes the center; even count takes the mean of the two centers
nomination.tie_break: higher median first, then lower layer index

noise.epsilon: standard normal float32 on a CPU generator
noise.h_source: unpatched teacher-forced scoring forward at the recipient question mark
noise.a_minus_source: prompt-only donor forward at the donor question mark; no donor answer appended
noise.seed_formula: seed + 10007 * layer + 1000003 * pair_index + (1000000007 if group == retain else 0)
noise.pair_index: 0 for promptdonor-01 through 9 for promptdonor-10; retain probes use 0..9 in selected order

shuffle.algorithm: random.Random(20261111).shuffle on donor-01..donor-10; the first shuffle is a derangement

retain.author_span: literal text between 'Where was ' and ' born?'
retain.scored_span: city only, same answer-span rule as y_plus

expected_probes.author_span: the renowned war genre writer Rhoda Mbalazi

downstream_check.probe: set the first residual coordinate to 0 if it is nonzero, otherwise set it to 1
downstream_check.pass_if: watched next-layer input max abs diff > 0

target_signal.greedy: manual argmax, 16 new tokens, hooks removed
target_signal.pass_if: decoded continuation with special tokens removed, after stripping leading whitespace, equals y_plus or continues with a non-alphanumeric boundary

confirmation_claim.donor_specific_positive_clusters: at least 3 of the 4 confirmation clusters have signal PASS and donor_specific > 0
confirmation_claim.selectivity_did_median: median over signal-passing confirmation clusters of (donor_specific_forget - mean retain donor_specific) > 0
confirmation_claim.retain_required: at least one signal-passing retain probe; otherwise selectivity is BLOCKED

source_gate.pass_if: exactly one preferred-or-normal P19 and the English label equals donor_fact_value
